_comment: Curated figure catalogue. This file is the reproducibility record for the
figures the agent can show a user: re-running 05_extract_figures.py against
Coordinates are PDF points measured from the top-left of the page.
mode 'page' crops away the repeated furniture (the vertical section tabs down
the right margin and the footer) and then trims whitespace, which yields a
tight figure for the many pages that ARE a single labelled diagram.
mode 'rect' is used where one page holds several independent answers - the
weld-diagnosis pages, where showing the whole sheet when someone asks about
porosity would bury the answer among four other defects. Those rects come
from the printed heading positions, so each crop is a self-contained unit of
defect photo + its causes and solutions.
'answers' entries are matched against user questions to help the agent pick a
figure, and double as documentation of why each figure earns its place.
